card.name: "Of" after risk or reports
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after "risk" or "postmarketing reports" in warning sections, just before a named adverse event. Also fires on a few words like "behavior" or "human" in similar warning text.

modes.label: "of" before adverse event
modes.description: The word "of" after "reports" or "risk", leading into a named condition such as pancreatitis or ONJ.
modes.example: There have been postmarketing reports<< of>> acute pancreatitis, including fatal and non

modes.label: Other warning words
modes.description: A word such as "behavior" or "human" in the middle of a warning phrase.
modes.example: The increased risk of suicidal thoughts or<< behavior>> with AEDs was observed as early
